content.value: Finish, don't start: ship all four slices in dependency order (stamp → pulse ∥ events → locks strip) and seal the wave with the epic's own criterion 2 — a REAL epic-cycle builder that stamps its criteria mid-claim while a human-watchable bp tasks board shows the locks flipping and the now-line breathing. items.value: One substrate (D1): the events feed is a projection of the task ledger's own write path, not a second store. If a slice wants its own table of truth, it is a fork — redesign.

Stamp is progress, close is the seal (D3): stamp --met writes evidence into the criterion in place; --miss records the honest attempt WITHOUT flipping the lock. Close still validates the full set. Stamp/pulse must authenticate as the claim holder (worker + epoch CAS) — a lapsed claim cannot stamp.
Pulse extends the existing rail-awareness lease renewal rather than inventing a parallel heartbeat: one atomic write = now-line text + lease renewal. Two writes racing is a bug by design review.

Vocabulary pinned (D2): the locks strip renders 1:1 from design/tokens.json lifecycle — ○ dim → ○ bright → braille spinner blue → ✓ teal, ! amber blocked. taskboard already owns anim.go (braille) and activityband.go; reuse, don't re-invent. Goldens update in the same PR as the renderer.

Quality bar: §0 of the task design-language spec is the acceptance test — it must feel alive; you always feel progress. A board that only repaints on manual refresh fails the wave even if every API test is green.

blocks.text: What the survey established

items.value: Events substrate SETTLED (D1): mutation_events is a durable append-only bigserial-ordered table every task op already writes in-transaction through one funnel (Tasks.Internal.insert_mutation_event! → Content.Broadcast.save_event). EventLog.replay_since/4 is a production keyset ?since= cursor (SSE resume at /v1/data/listen); Prime.recent_events already runs the task-filtered query shape; sync_push_cursors + github cursor already treat mutation_events.id as an external cursor. /v1/tasks/events?since= = thin projection. NO new store.

Stamp is genuinely new: acceptance-criteria writes exist ONLY inside Close (merge_criteria/apply_criteria_update, private — advisory lock, in-lock re-read, index-targeted List.replace_at, rev CAS). Stamp = extract that write path into a shared module + graft Close.check_fencing/2 (epoch CAS). Mutations.relabel_by_id is the closest shape template but carries NO fencing — copying it verbatim ships the bug.

Pulse = extend Claim.do_renew/3 — the shipped lease renewal is already ONE atomic Repo.update_all (epoch+1, ts_iso refresh, work_digest deliberately preserved) riding the same-worker targeted-claim branch (renewal?/2). Pulse adds the now-line to that SAME write; a second UPDATE reintroduces the racing-writes problem the charter bans.

CLI is free: a new verb = manifest map in plugins/tasks.ex cli_commands/0 + route tuple in register_routes/1 + controller action. Go dispatch is 100% manifest-driven (tree.Lookup → runCommand) — zero Go per verb. MCP exposure is a SEPARATE hand-maintained step in mcp_tasks.go. There is no alias layer: the manifest verb string IS the only spelling.

Vocabulary pinned & gated: design/tokens.json lifecycle block (braille-blue spinner, ✓ teal deliberately ≠ status-ok green, ! amber, ○ bright=ready / ○ dim=open) flows via emit.mjs into taskboard tokens_gen.go, Studio TokensGen, and CSS — with design/check.mjs 4-way parity and api/test board_theme_parity_test.exs as live tripwires. Locks-strip reuses spinnerGlyph/GenLifecycle; goldens regen via `go test ./internal/taskboard/... -update`, same PR.

Board liveness does NOT depend on the events feed: the TUI board already self-refreshes (SSE dirty-bit → 750ms debounced full refetch + 30s backstop; events NEVER carry truth), and Studio /admin/projects subscribes to the same broadcast. The feed's value is the durable replayable narration trail for surfaces without that plumbing — plus the ?since= cursor for agents.

blocks.text: Verification results — what the deep round proved

items.value: mid-claim criteria stamp → default-path close returns {:error, {:doc_changed_since_claim, …, ["acceptance_criteria"]}} — the wave's core loop was broken by construction. WorkDigest hashes the FULL criteria entries (work_digest.ex:20,32,85-92). Ruling: D5 narrows the digest to criterion text, inside the stamp slice. No work_digest_test.exs exists — no golden churn.

claim/ttl_sweeper/compactor lock task:<doc_id> (string); close/release/move/fence/mutations lock task:<uuid>. Cross-family mutex defeated; safe today only via FOR UPDATE row lock + rev-CAS. The 'SAME key close uses' comments are false across families. Ruling: D6 — stamp joins the close family, pulse the renewal family; convergence = backlog.

do_renew is the right one-atomic-write template but rides claim_by_id, whose fall-through silently RE-CLAIMS with a fresh digest when the lease lapsed — a pulse must refuse (not_holder), so it gets its own write path. Both epoch AND worker are world-readable (show returns full claim); holder check = coordination guard, token = the only security boundary. Ruling: D7.

an attempts[] key survives BOTH validation layers untouched — no migration. But Params.parse_criteria silently DROPS unknown keys and both parse+merge default met→true when absent ({'index':0} → met:true) — the exact footgun a naive --miss would inherit. No array bound exists anywhere; the 5-entry cap is app code. Ruling: D8.

tail cursor = 0.39ms on the bare PK; cold since=0 replay seq-scans (17ms @63k rows, forced index 156ms) — index is backlog, not launch. Prime.recent_events has NO id field and sorts by inserted_at — replay-unsafe, do not reuse; write a fresh replay_since-shaped query. Route must mount above /tasks/:doc_id (prime precedent, live 404-shadow otherwise). Pulse's filed brief had ZERO event-emission criterion — fixed at Decide. Ruling: D10, and pulse ∥ events re-sequenced to pulse → events.

go build/vet/test + all goldens pass; -update regen is byte-identical to HEAD; board_theme_parity 4/4 green when isolated. Shared api/_build/test is ACTIVELY CONTAMINATED by a concurrent worktree (media_upload_dir mismatch, red 3/3 in the main checkout) — Elixir gates run in the builder's own isolated worktree build, a shared-checkout red is contamination first. Board row today renders only a bare N/M fraction; the ladder is a NEW token; charter's activityband.go never existed. Ruling: D11 + doctrine line added.

fresh binary from this checkout ran task get against guerrilla through the fully generic manifest dispatcher; capabilities ETag is content-addressed (proved a real 304 round-trip) — new verbs appear on the next bp invocation, zero Go, zero cache-bust. task.stamp/task.pulse exist NOWHERE yet (repo + live manifest greps empty) — genuinely greenfield. taskboard's pulseMsg is an unrelated SSE keepalive — docstring disambiguation ordered in D9.

blocks.text: Decisions (charter D5–D13 is canonical — one line each)

items.value: WorkDigest narrows to the brief: criteria hash by criterion text only; met/evidence/attempts never trip the close fence; ships inside stamp — because the proven 409 otherwise breaks stamp-then-close.

Stamp locks task:<uuid> (serializes with close, the seal); pulse locks task:<doc_id> (serializes with the TTL reap); rev-CAS stays the cross-family contract — because the lock split is real and rev-CAS is what actually guards.

Both verbs holder-gated (check_holder → Tasks.Internal); stamp epoch-fences like close, pulse never epoch-fences and refuses a lost lease — because evidence binds to a live lease while a keepalive must survive fences.

Wire vocabulary pinned: task.criterion + task.pulse mutation kinds, one emitter funnel; --met requires evidence; --miss = bounded attempts[] {note,ts,worker} ×5, met pinned explicitly — because the met→true parse default is a proven lock-flipping footgun.
claim.now {text,ts,criterion?} written in the SAME update_all as the lease renewal; module Barkpark.Tasks.Pulse — because two writes race and bare Barkpark.Pulse is Shared Storm's.
Events feed = new keyset projection over mutation_events with id AS the cursor, mounted above :doc_id; no migration now — because Prime's shape is replay-unsafe and the tail is already 0.39ms.

Board ladder with ZERO new glyphs (✓ teal / ! amber miss / spinner only on the pulse-named criterion / ○), all from GenLifecycle — because it keeps the glyph allowlist, theme parity, and the Go-only merge lane intact.
'Every board' = TUI + Studio + papers-reader embeds this wave; web embed/CLI/MCP filed as backlog — because one-shot surfaces can't breathe and honesty beats silent claims.
task-566d782d09bd0eea cancelled as superseded (criteria contradict shipped do_renew); cmux half re-filed — because two renewal code paths is exactly the fork D1 bans.
